Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished SIX-FRAME full-body Hanni sprite animation sheet from the attached original high-resolution Hanni reference. Exactly same appealing fox identity, brown eyes, red-orange plush fur, cream muzzle/tail tip, brown paws/ear tips, detailed red-cream-gold Hanfu and 汉 pendant. Soft premium 3D plush style, graceful anatomy, exact TWO arms/paws, TWO feet, ONE tail. Overall SQUARE canvas, THREE columns x TWO rows, six separate newly DRAWN images on true alpha transparency. Generous padding so no character or props touch another cell or sheet border. No backdrop, floor, cast shadows, grid, labels or captions.
All six form ONE circular action. Fixed camera/scale/lighting, stable torso, coat hem, foot placement and tail side. Head and acting limb can make small incremental motions as specified, no whole-body sway or size changes. Keep face shape and costume consistent. Frame6 must be adjacent to1, never an abrupt reset. Clear purposeful movement, not six near-static copies. Red book when used is neat, moderate size, gold text exactly HanNi. No extra props or arms.
E19 SEARCHING A BOOK, redesigned natural purposeful pose. Standing balanced in a slight three-quarter angle. One paw naturally supports ONE small OPEN red HanNi book below chest at waist, visible cream pages tilted upward. The OTHER paw holds ONE small gold MAGNIFYING GLASS over the book's OUTER canvas-right page, BELOW and OUTSIDE the fox's face. Lens diameter only about1/4 face width. Clear transparent glass or empty clear opening in gold rim, no opaque beige/gold disk, no enlarged eyeball. Handle gripped beneath lens by exactly one paw, no third support hand. Curious gentle closed smile and normal eyes looking DOWN toward book/lens. Muzzle, ears and ornate collar unobstructed. Six phases of a gentle search:1 lens over outer page near top;2 lens moves12px down-right;3 lens at lower outer point;4 lens moves through lower center toward book;5 lens slightly up-left toward starting position;6 lens moves back near phase1. Total lens oval travel about24px at512px. Keep lens on same side and close to page ALLsix. Head can nod2degrees toward page through first3 and return through last3; do not change head proportions or torso. No lens covering any eye/nose/mouth. Tail remains canvas-left.
